# RFCs

## Why this file exists

This directory holds the project's RFCs (Requests For Comments).
Use one when a design decision is contested, cross-cutting, or
load-bearing for the bounded context. Accepted RFCs should
update `DECISION_LOG.md` and (when behavior changes) `SPEC.md`.

RFC 0007 has landed as the `kayakgen` package, CLI, compatibility
shims, and golden regression tests. RFC 0005 has landed only as a raw
comparative resistance filter; calibrated final-prediction claims,
validity envelopes, Pareto-default scoring, and 200 ms full-curve
interactive latency remain deferred. RFCs 0004, 0006, and 0008 remain
partial as of workflow 0010: they have useful implementation, but their
acceptance criteria are not fully satisfied.

RFCs 0009-0013 are roadmap RFCs for the pivot from single-hull generation to a
reproducible generative pipeline. RFC 0013's report/CLI slice has landed; web
comparison UI remains deferred. The remaining proposed items are intentionally
sequenced from run records and mesh diagnostics toward stability, resistance
calibration, and Pareto comparison.

## Template

Use `0001-template.md` as a starting point. Copy it, give the
file a number-prefixed name (`0002-foo-bar.md`), and replace
the placeholders.

The optional `## Domain Modeling` section identifies which DDD
pattern the new concept fits (aggregate root, value object,
domain event, or boundary clarification) and cites the
appropriate `DDD.md § "Adding to the model"` step.
